purpose: Candidate deterministic state criteria for Phase Zero freeze review. They are not executed by the TEST-ONLY calibration and must be approved before real diagnostics.
leakage_rule: Rubric criteria and expected values are evaluator inputs only and must not be exposed to either C1 or C2 receivers.

criteria.criterion: Records the standard MSA, deal-economics summary, and exclusivity letter as the complete released source set.
Records the standard positions that are supported by the released MSA without inventing unavailable counterparty or authority facts.
Records TCV, ACV, initial term, exclusivity deadline, and other released timing constraints with source bindings.
Marks authority, counterparty position, and legal-risk fields that cannot yet be resolved as pending rather than guessed.
Selects Prism MSA redline v3 as the operative counterparty draft and preserves the S1 source state.
Identifies all seven out-of-policy issue families and records standard versus current counterparty positions with source bindings.
Incorporates negotiation-history status without treating a proposal, discussion, or concession as an approval.
Records the Designated Competitor schedule, including the Sable Media objection and its stated basis, without resolving authority not yet released.
Uses the newly released authority matrix to identify the ACV, term, and substantive deviations requiring escalation.
Incorporates the business case and outside-counsel risk assessment while keeping business preference, legal risk, and formal approval distinct.
Revalidates affected issue states after the cold boundary and preserves still-supported S1/S2 state with explicit source/version bindings.
Does not infer final CMO or General Counsel authorization from the released advisory or authority materials.
Runs the unchanged upstream 72-criterion final Harvey evaluator against the final memo; local criteria do not replace or relabel that score.
Records the escalation-request email as the final released instruction and keeps Prism redline v3 as the operative contract version.
Carries all seven issue states, their evidence, risk, disposition, and delegated-authority status into the final work product without unsafe superseded-state propagation.
Reports final legal-work-product quality, state consistency, unsafe propagation, recovery, false-stop, and cost families separately.
